item.title: Eurostat: EU household gas prices decrease in first half of 2026
item.description: Europese Commissie, 30-10-2026. In the first half of 2026, average gas prices for EU households fell to €0.11 per kilowatt-hour (kWh). Prices decreased by 10.2% compared with the second semester of 2025 and by 3.5% compared with the first semester of 2025.

item.title: Eurostat: Household electricity prices ease in 1st half of 2026
item.description: Europese Commissie, 30-10-2026. In the first half of 2026, average electricity prices for households in the EU decreased by 2.2% to €0.28, down from €0.29 per kWh in the second half of 2025. Prices remained well above levels from before the 2022 energy crisis.
